date_policy: Actual literal Opening, Market Update or Update title M/D/MMDD with independently reviewed 2014 archive/source context. Generic Opening Print dates remain null. No URL, image-name, adjacent-date or archive-clock repair.
undated_year_context: Two literal Opening Print bodies contain prospective overnight/opening plans and ESH5 context. One was observed in late December 2014 and the other in early January 2015. They remain qualified 2014 source context without assigning an exact day.
retitled_feed_revisions: September 12/16 Update revisions and later Opening revisions have identical IDs, bodies, ordered links and image elements. Later Opening entries are explicit primary selections; raw earlier titles remain unchanged.
